name: pdf-mcp
description: Read, search, and pull tables out of PDFs, one file or a whole folder, without hitting Claude's page limit.
long_description: pdf-mcp gives Claude 13 tools for PDFs: page-level reads, hybrid keyword and semantic search, tables, table of contents, page renders, chart data, and search across a folder of PDFs. Everything runs on your computer. Works in Claude Desktop's Chat. The first start downloads its components and needs an internet connection. Scanned PDFs need Tesseract for OCR; see the OCR setup link in the documentation.

update_check.title: Check for updates
update_check.description: Once a day, ask PyPI whether a newer pdf-mcp exists, so Claude can tell you. Sends no information about you or your PDFs.

tools.name: pdf_info
tools.description: Page count, metadata, table of contents summary, scanned-page detection.

tools.name: pdf_search
tools.description: Hybrid keyword and semantic search inside one PDF, with paragraph excerpts.

tools.name: pdf_read_pages
tools.description: Read specific pages, with OCR, tables, and images on demand.

tools.name: pdf_read_all
tools.description: Read a whole document in one call, size-capped.

tools.name: pdf_render_pages
tools.description: Render pages as images for diagrams, handwriting, and scans.

tools.name: pdf_extract_chart
tools.description: Chart data as exact (x, y) tables from plot geometry.

tools.name: pdf_corpus_warm
tools.description: Index a folder of PDFs within a time budget.

tools.name: pdf_corpus_overview
tools.description: One triage card per document in a folder.

tools.name: pdf_corpus_search
tools.description: Search across every PDF in a folder, with document and page provenance.

tools.name: pdf_cache_clear
tools.description: Clear expired or all cache entries.

tools.name: server_info
